description:
Four test modules that exercise the examples from Track G using the four-rung test
harness from Track F. Each ticket is a single test file. Together they validate that
all of the framework's capabilities (component isolation, observables, holds, event
closures) work correctly in a realistic app context.

  H1 — TodoList tests (test/filament/examples/todo_test.exs)
       Rung-1 domain tests for Todo.Store, rung-2 component isolation for TodoList.
       Validates defcomponent, use_state, event closures, keyed list re-render.

  H2 — Cart tests (test/filament/examples/cart_test.exs)
       All four rungs. Rung-1 Cart.State domain, rung-2 CartBadge stub isolation,
       rung-3 CartView with real Cart.Server, rung-4 LiveView integration.
       Projection test: badge does not receive update when count is unchanged.

  H3 — Inventory tests (test/filament/examples/inventory_test.exs)
       Rung-1 process-death hold-release, rung-2 CheckoutLineItem out-of-stock UX.
       Validates use_hold, :DOWN-triggered release, out-of-stock component path.

  H4 — Collaboration tests (test/filament/examples/collaboration_test.exs)
       Rung-3 real Document.Server. Lock acquired/rejected, lock released on
       process death, presence count tracking.

The four rungs (from Track F — flm-j92):
  Rung 1 — Plain ExUnit, pure OTP. No Filament test infrastructure needed.
  Rung 2 — Filament.Test.mount/3 with observable stubs (Filament.Test.Stub).
            Filament.Test.click/2, Filament.Test.submit/3, Filament.Test.render_text/1,
            Filament.Test.has_class?/3. No WebSocket.
  Rung 3 — Real test-started GenServer. Filament.Test.update/1 to drain messages.
            Filament.Test.eventually/2 for async assertions.
  Rung 4 — Phoenix.LiveViewTest wrapper (Filament.Test.LiveView).

Prerequisites (all must be merged before any H ticket can start):
  Track G (flm-g5b) — all four example apps in examples/
  Track F (flm-j92) — Filament.Test module and all four rung APIs

Dependency chain mirrors Track G:
  flm-g5b.1 + flm-j92 → H1 → H2 (+ flm-g5b.2 + F2 + F3)
                             → H3 (+ flm-g5b.3)
  H2 + H3 + flm-g5b.4 + flm-j92.3 → H4

Track H is a prerequisite for Track I (docs), which uses these examples as its
narrative substrate.

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html §04 (Tests section)
title: Track H: Tests — exercising the four examples with the Filament test harness
